text: Madgy Figgy, also called Madge Figgy, was a Cornish heroine and witch of Cornwall. She lived near Raftra and made her living scrounging debris from wrecked ships. Some believed she magically called up storms to cause such wrecks. She sat on a huge basalt rock off Land's End that has a level space on its top, where she could invoke the weather spirits. Once she and her crew of wreckers found the body of a Portuguese lady drowned in one of the storms Madgy Figgy had raised. The witch claimed the jewels the woman wore and hid them in a chest in her house. Every night after, a strange light traveled to Madgy's cottage. At last a stranger came to town and followed the exact path of the light. When he left he had all the woman's jewels, and Madgy had a fortune in ransom. One witch knows another, living or dead, she said.
